parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly of a cooling fan, made of ABS plastic for durability and lightweight performance.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, cooling electronic components or circulating air in a system.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the cooling fan, made of polycarbonate for structural rigidity and heat resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the fan blades and motor, providing a stable housing and mounting points for installation.
parts.Movement_description: This part remains stationary, serving as the structural support for the rotating fan assembly.
